name: bosi-programming-skills
description: Bosi's LLM skills: three-axis code review and the code-standards catalog it checks against, a commit-and-open-PR workflow gated on that review, UML diagrams of a codebase or a description on a live, editable page, NFR docs written and reviewed against ISO/IEC 25010, an output-shape gate for summaries and posts, an epistemic-action gate against predicting instead of checking, a phased recipe workflow from task to merged PR, a sub-agent relay that runs that recipe hands-off in the current session, a parent-issue orchestrator that runs it once per sub-issue and then integrates, QAs and merges them behind human gates, a work-session note writer, a pause step that saves half-done work as a task for tomorrow, a weekly review built from those notes, and a setup skill that writes the settings file the others read.
